item.title: 2026 Petaluma River Craft Beer Festival — Sat Sep 12, 1:00 PM — Water Street @ Petaluma River
item.description: Discounted early bird tickets are now on sale for the 12th annual Petaluma River Craft Beer Festival Saturday, September 12 from 1-5 p.m. in historic downtown Petaluma where attendees can enjoy craft beer tastings from two dozen regional breweries, delicious food from several of Petaluma’s top restaurants and live music from local bands. General admission includes beer glass, beer tastings and live music. Limited reduced price “designated driver” tickets are also available for $25 and include snacks, nonalcoholic beverages and a $10 gift certificate for event food purchases. item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Sep 13, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Let's Play Chinese Mahjong! — Sun Sep 13, 2:00 PM — Cloverdale Library
item.description:
Learn to play Chinese \(Hong Kong-style\) mahjong, or come play with friends if you already know the game! We will have sets and instructors on site to teach the game and help with rules and scoring. Mahjong is a game for multi-generations; it keeps the mind sharp with a basic set of rules that can be learned in 30 minutes, and adds unending ways to add strategy and challenge; it builds community and sustains culture; it's fun and addicting in a wholesome way! 'Four Flowers Mahjong Salon' goal is to bring mahjong to the Sonoma County area. They currently teach at private homes, farmers markets, tasting rooms, and coffee shops!
Source: Press Democrat

item.title: Sonoma Sundays on the Plaza - Groove Incident & Mitch Woods — Sun Sep 13, 2:00 PM — Grinstead Amphitheater
item.description:
This summer, Music in Place and the City of Sonoma invite you to soak up the sunshine, sip local wine, and dance to live music at the Sonoma Plaza Grinstead Amphitheater during Sonoma Sundays On the Plaza, a free concert series running June 7 through October 4, 2026.
Every Sunday from 2:00–5:00 PM, the Plaza comes alive with an exciting mix of musical styles: blues, soul, country, jazz, swing, Americana, mariachi, and more. With a fresh lineup of acclaimed artists, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.
Sonoma Sundays is all about creating opportunities for the community to come together through the power of live music. Music in Place is excited to bring an incredible range of artists to the Plaza this summer and continue building connections through music.
Sonoma Sundays are free and open to all, thanks to the generous support of the Sonoma Community Center, The Dawn Redwoods Trust, and the KHR McNeely Family Foundation.

item.title: Watercolor | Building Technique II, with Nancy Ballard — Tue Sep 15, 10:00 AM — Petaluma Arts Center
item.description:
Building on the skills and confidence you developed in the first class, this watercolor workshop invites you to take your ideas a step further. Explore how a simple sketch, thoughtful composition, and expressive use of color can transform an idea into a finished painting.
We'll work larger and bolder while exploring watercolor techniques including:
Wet-on-wet paintingLoose interpretation and expressive mark-makingCreating shadows and depthEnhancing backgroundsWorking in black and whiteExploring the many variations and possibilities of mixing greens
Bring a favorite photograph, a live flower or small plant, or even a meaningful memory to use as inspiration. No matter where you are in your artistic journey, you'll be encouraged to experiment, have fun, and focus on the larger picture rather than striving for perfection. There are no mistakes in art—only opportunities to explore.
Please Note: There will be a $10 supply fee paid directly to the Nancy on the day of the class.

U.S. Latinos represent nearly a $4 trillion economy and are among the fastest-growing economic forces in the nation. Hector will bring that story home to Sonoma County, highlighting the impact of Latino entrepreneurs, the challenges they face, and how local businesses and community partners can share in this growth. item.description:
Cuentos con Ritmo \(Stories with Rhythm\)
Cuentos con Ritmo | Cuentos \* Música \* Movimiento
Presentado por Colors of Spanish
Cuentos con Ritmo es una oportunidad única semanal para niños de 1 a 5 años y sus familias, el cual aporta alegría, comprensión y aprecio por la lengua española a toda la comunidad. Durante Cuentos con Ritmo, los pequeños visitantes y sus familias participan de forma lúdica en historias interactivas con música y movimiento fortaleciendo nuestra diversa comunidad y entusiasmo por la lengua meta.
Cuentos con Ritmo es presentado por Guadalupe Tausch en colaboración con la organización que fundó, Colors of Spanish. item.description:
Mikayla McVey writes & performs from the beating, blistered, blissed out heart of the West. Born in Virginia and raised up in the holy golden Northern California hills, McVey has come to understand music as a major thread that ties together community and an opportunity to practice magic in one of its most accessible & transmittable forms. Music has always been home and she genuinely hopes / time turns everything / into song.
She currently resides in Oakland, California, and has made homes in rural South America, Los Angeles, Las Vegas, and the 35ft cavern of a 1986 International School bus named Splendor.

item.description:
Cuentos con Ritmo \(Stories with Rhythm\)
Cuentos con Ritmo | Cuentos \* Música \* Movimiento
Presentado por Colors of Spanish
Cuentos con Ritmo es una oportunidad única semanal para niños de 1 a 5 años y sus familias, el cual aporta alegría, comprensión y aprecio por la lengua española a toda la comunidad. Durante Cuentos con Ritmo, los pequeños visitantes y sus familias participan de forma lúdica en historias interactivas con música y movimiento fortaleciendo nuestra diversa comunidad y entusiasmo por la lengua meta.
Cuentos con Ritmo es presentado por Guadalupe Tausch en colaboración con la organización que fundó, Colors of Spanish. Originaria del estado de Guanajuato en México, tiene una maestría en español con énfasis en la adquisición de una segunda lengua para la primera infancia y continúa sus estudios enfocada en la primera infancia especializándose en la adquisición de idiomas a través de la música/movimiento.
